def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_list = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    def route_load(r):
        s = 0
        for n in r:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def route_cost(r):
        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        c += matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes)

        idx_of = {c: k for k, c in enumerate(customers_list)}  # customer -> route index

        custs = customers_list
        savings = []
        for i in range(len(custs)):
            a = custs[i]
            da = matrix[depot][a]
            for j in range(i + 1, len(custs)):
                b = custs[j]
                s = da + matrix[depot][b] - matrix[a][b]
                # tie-breaker deterministic: larger savings first, then smaller max-id, then pair
                savings.append((s, -max(a, b), a, b))
        savings.sort(reverse=True)

        def endpoints_of(route):
            if not route:
                return None, None
            return route[0], route[-1]

        # Route indices can disappear when merged; mark merged-out routes with None
        for (s, _, a, b) in savings:
            ia = idx_of.get(a, None)
            ib = idx_of.get(b, None)
            if ia is None or ib is None or ia == ib:
                continue
            if routes[ia] is None or routes[ib] is None:
                continue
            end_a0, end_a1 = endpoints_of(routes[ia])
            end_b0, end_b1 = endpoints_of(routes[ib])

            merged = False
            # Cases:
            # [ ... a ] + [ b ... ]  -> a is tail of ia, b is head of ib
            if end_a1 == a and end_b0 == b and load[ia] + load[ib] <= capacity:
                routes[ia] = routes[ia] + routes[ib]
                load[ia] += load[ib]
                routes[ib] = None
                merged = True
            # [ ... b ] + [ a ... ]  -> b is tail of ib, a is head of ia
            elif end_b1 == b and end_a0 == a and load[ia] + load[ib] <= capacity:
                routes[ib] = routes[ib] + routes[ia]
                load[ib] += load[ia]
                routes[ia] = None
                # swap ia/ib for mapping update logic
                ia, ib = ib, ia
                merged = True
            # [ a ... ] + [ ... b ] -> a is head of ia, b is tail of ib
            elif end_a0 == a and end_b1 == b and load[ia] + load[ib] <= capacity:
                routes[ib] = routes[ib][:-1]  # placeholder to keep structure? avoid; just reverse concat
                # Reverse ia and merge: ia = reverse(ia) gives a at tail
                routes[ia] = list(reversed(routes[ia])) + list(reversed(routes[ib]))
                load[ia] = load[ia] + load[ib]
